newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to use IMF aid package-Singson.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to use IMF aid package-Singson.

text.p: The Philippines will use the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) financial package, Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday.
He said the Monetary Board had agreed to draw down on the $1.05 billion package. The IMF Board is meeting on Friday to approve the loan package.
Singson declined to elaborate on when and how much it will draw from the facility, but said it would be available next week.

IMF managing director Michel Camdessus said last week that he would recommend to the IMF board to make additional financial resources available to the Philippines to help it cope with its currency crisis.
